changelog:
**v2.8.0 introduces new multi-model AI image generation support and recent workflow optimizations:**

- Added three alternative image generation backends (火山即梦 Seedream, Google Gemini, Agnes AI) available via `IMAGE_API` environment variable.
- Default image generator for WorkBuddy is now Tencent 混元 (内置 ImageGen); CLI platforms use Gemini by default.
- Users can switch image model via `IMAGE_API=volcengine|gemini|agnes` (with relevant API keys).
- Background music, transition sound effects, and animated subtitle entrance/exit now supported (introduced in v2.7.0).
- Default TTS speech rate increased to 1.2x for greater efficiency; matches previous workflow.
- Deprecated previous "画面缩放" (Ken Burns effect); now uses fixed visuals with entrance animation.
- Documentation updated to include platform-specific instructions and environmental variables for all backends.
